note: A developer's list of what could go wrong and which requirements address it. Not a formal hazard analysis, not complete, and no likelihood or severity has been estimated.

hazards.hazard: The operator acts on vehicle data that is no longer current.
causes: mission progress shown after AEGIS lost track of it
hazards.residual: Thresholds were chosen for one simulator. A real radio link can drop and reorder packets in ways not yet tested.

hazards.hazard: Simulated or replayed data is taken for a real aircraft, or the reverse.
causes: a replay shown without its label
hazards.residual: The physical path has only been unit-tested; no physical autopilot has been connected.

hazards.hazard: Software meant for simulation commands a physical aircraft.
causes: a real autopilot on the simulator's port
hazards.residual: The simulator check relies on parameters only PX4's simulator build reports; a modified firmware could imitate them.

hazards.hazard: AI or monitor output moves the vehicle without an operator decision.
hazards.residual: The navigation auto-hold (AEGIS_NAV_AUTO_HOLD) does command Hold by design; it is documented and can be turned off.

hazards.hazard: Someone other than the operator commands the vehicle.
hazards.residual: OPEN: the MAVSDK control port listens on every interface and cannot be restricted by the software. scripts/lock_mavsdk_port.sh blocks it but has not been checked from another computer. PX4 v1.17 has no MAVLink signing.

hazards.hazard: An incident is investigated from evidence that was altered, incomplete or misdescribed.
hazards.residual: Anyone holding the device key, or write access to the whole session including the audit log, can forge consistently. No external timestamp or anchor.
Only AEGIS's copy is faulted in tests; PX4's estimator is never given bad GNSS. Spoofing that is consistent with the reported velocity is not detected.

hazards.hazard: False alarms teach operators to ignore alerts.
causes: one fault showing as several alerts
hazards.residual: Measured on one simulator only. Real sensor noise is not represented.

hazards.hazard: A mission is flown outside the permitted area.
hazards.residual: AEGIS also uploads the fence to PX4, whose own geofence enforces it in flight; that enforcement is PX4's, not tested here.

hazards.hazard: Fault injection reaches a real vehicle.
causes: fault injection enabled on a physical setup
